app.title: Membership card generator
app.privacy: Member data never leaves this computer: everything is processed in the browser and discarded when you close the tab.

auth.title: Board access
auth.intro: Sign in with your club account ({'@'}{domain}).
auth.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again.
auth.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
auth.notClub: The account {email} is not a club account. Sign in with your {'@'}{domain} account.

gallery.title: Templates
gallery.help: Choose the template to generate the cards with. From here you can also add a new one (try it before saving it), approve it for a season, rename it or delete it.
gallery.add: Add a template: drop the SVG here or click to choose it
gallery.noneSelected: You haven't chosen a template yet.

members.title: Members
members.needTemplate: Choose a template in step 1 to check the members.

card.title: Card fields
card.needMembers: Load the members list in step 2 to generate the cards. Meanwhile, the preview shows the sample text.
card.needColumns: Some CSV column is still missing in step 2.

template.none: No season has an official template: load the SVG of a new template or approve one from the library.
template.loadFailed: The official templates could not be loaded.
template.missing: The template assigned to {season} is no longer in the library. Approve another one for that season.

publish.title: Save to the library
publish.help: Save it to the library for the whole board. You can approve it now as the official one for a season or just save it for later. Check the preview first.
publish.replaceWarning: The {season} season has "{name}" approved: this one will replace it. "{name}" stays in the library.
publish.failed: The template could not be published. Please try again.
publish.done: "{name}" is the official template for the {season} season.
publish.name: Name
publish.badName: Give it a name (80 characters at most).

library.cannotDelete: It is assigned to a season: approve another one before deleting it.
library.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}" from the library? This cannot be undone.
library.noHistory: No approvals recorded (it was published before the history existed).
library.confirmUnassign: {season} will be left without an official template (its history is kept).
library.failed: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

csv.drop: Drop the CSV file here or click to choose it
csv.unreadable: The file could not be read.

mapping.help: Tell us which column of the file holds each piece of card data.

cardSeason.label: Season of the cards
cardSeason.printed: On the card: {list}. Approving the template for a season sets it automatically.

validation.waiting: Load the member list and choose the columns to review it.

issues.does-not-fit: {field}: “{value}” does not fit even at the minimum size

download.title: Download
download.reportHelp: You can fix it and load it again to generate only those cards.
download.failed: The PDF could not be generated: {error}
download.doesNotFit: {cols} × {rows} cards do not fit on an A4 sheet.
download.duplexHelp: Print it double-sided, flipping on the long edge: each sheet of fronts is followed by its sheet of backs.
